title: Concept: Deployment hook URL in a response
description: A Render deploy hook URL in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The hook triggers a deploy of whatever is on the tracked branch, so a leaked hook lets an outsider force rollouts, exhaust build minutes, or pair with a repo write to ship code.
applicability: Deployments that render a Render deploy hook URL into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The hook triggers a deploy of whatever is on the tracked branch, so a leaked hook lets an outsider force rollouts, exhaust build minutes, or pair with a repo write to ship code.
